definition_zh: 用相同参数坐标描述几何及场变量的八节点单元。
usage_note: 所引模型将隧道衬砌假定为理想弹性材料。
usage_overview: 在车辆—轨道—山岭隧道相互作用分析中，用作离散隧道衬砌的三维实体单元，表示衬砌结构并参与系统动力响应计算。该应用模型将衬砌材料假定为理想弹性。

complete_examples.text: After the finite element meshing of the lining, the 8-node isoparametric element is used for simulation.

An isoparametric element permutation method proposed in 9 is introduced, where the surrounding rock mass is formed by 6- and 8-node isoparametric element, and its element sizes in lateral directions, e.g., w1, w2 and w3, and vertical direction, e.g., h1, h2 and h3, are set to be non-uniform, namely the mesh size is enlarged against the element distance to the excitation source, so as to reduce the degrees of freedom the finite element rock mass model.
